notation.P; id,v; T: Exact profile identity/revision and selected Definition subject representation.
notation.Sel; S; I; s; g: Exact subject/input selection, one Definition version, input state, authority/applicability scope and named phase.
notation.C; Omega; O_e; B: Finite declared check identities, outcome vocabulary, one complete evaluation result map and causal blocker contract.
notation.G; R(P,g); A: Declared phases, required aggregation subset for one phase, and its outcome rule. Completeness of check reporting and phase aggregation are different obligations.
notation.o; L: Qualified profile owner and explicit coverage/authority claim limits.
notation.ConformingEvaluation; ExactBinding: Interpretation of a conforming completed evidence record, not a guarantee that every attempt succeeds. Relevant subject/profile/input versions and scope must match.

definition-evaluation-profile.standing: author interpretation; formal execution and owner fidelity pending
operational_explanation: Every declared check receives a scoped result or an explicit not-evaluable blocker; only the named phase subset contributes to its aggregate.
A required check with missing applicable evidence is NOT_EVALUABLE; an established violation is FAIL. Missing evidence is not a proof of violation.
Admission-selection/application checks can be reported as pending while excluded from pre-decision aggregation.

definition-lifecycle-profile.formal_expression:
P=(id,v,T,Q,q0,E,Gate,Effect,o,s,Invalidate,History); E subseteq Q x Q.
PermittedBy(P,d,a,b,I) iff ExactBinding(P,d,I) and (a,b) in E and Gate(P,d,a,b,I)=PASS.
PermittedBy(P,d,a,b,I) does not entail TransitionRecorded(d,a,b) or EffectApplied(d,Effect(P,a,b)).
ConsistentAdmittedState(d) requires applicable exact owner admission selection and confirmed application; declaration alone provides neither.

notation.P; id,v; T; d: Exact profile identity/revision, selected Definition representation and one exact Definition version.
notation.Q; q0; E: Declared states, initial posture and finite directed transition pairs; no transition is inferred from independent state lists.
notation.Gate; I: Scoped requirements and exact evidence/authority input state. PASS establishes the gate; unknown or unsupported evidence does not establish permission.
notation.Effect; o; s: Declared effect, qualified authority owner and applicability scope. Effect selection and confirmed application remain separate facts.
notation.Invalidate; History: Rules for changed epochs, affected evidence invalidation and immutable historical state/receipt preservation.
notation.PermittedBy; TransitionRecorded; EffectA: Conditions allowing a transition, a separately attributable transition record and separately confirmed effect; none is silently substituted for another.

definition-lifecycle-profile.standing: author interpretation; formal execution and owner fidelity pending
operational_explanation: A permitted directed pair and satisfied gate do not move the subject automatically; each actual transition requires an attributable record and applicable confirmed effect.
Initial posture is a contract declaration, not evidence of another record’s actual state.
Pre-decision readiness is an assessment, not an extra lifecycle state. Defer/revise/reject outcomes do not silently create a withdrawal effect.

limits: No mechanized proof or unrestricted consistency claim.
Version/currentness and owner-authority predicates require actual scoped evidence.
A valid example structure is not owner fidelity acceptance.
